subject: Business-card OCR fallback & HubSpot sync for Summit A booths
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@scanfast.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: ScanFast Integration <integrations@scanfast.io>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Business-card OCR fallback option for Summit A booths

Hi Mateo & Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick demo on Friday. We heard the concerns about badge-scanner reliability in congested ingress points and wanted to propose a lightweight fallback that captures business-card images and runs an on-device OCR pass before forwarding structured contact data to HubSpot.

High-level:
- Capture: image taken by the booth rep or attendee (camera UI)
- Preprocess: low-latency crop + orientation correction on-device
- OCR: Tesseract-based pass with custom name/email heuristics (privacy mode available)
- Sync: valid records pushed to HubSpot via webhook; duplicates deduped against email/phone

We attached a short spec and a floor map showing where we think fallback should be available (main entrance + VIP lounge). Curious about your HubSpot field mapping and whether you want these records to land in a temporary "manual_capture" list for CS review or immediately into the existing event list.

If useful, we can ship a small APK/IPA for quick evaluation this week; otherwise we can run a 30-min test with a pairing to your kiosk devices.

Cheers,
Laura Chen
Head of Integrations | ScanFast, Inc.
attachments: scanfast_businesscard-ocr-spec_v1.2.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@scanfast.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Business-card OCR fallback option for Summit A booths

Thanks Laura — this looks promising. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Privacy / consent: We need explicit opt-in language before capturing images. Can you support a short consent banner that stores a consent flag with each record (timestamp + captured_by)? We can expose that flag in HubSpot and add it to the event record.

2) Data retention: For compliance we want images deleted after 14 days by default. OCR text can be kept longer if consented. Is that configurable?

3) HubSpot mapping: Ben, can you confirm the target properties we should map to (source, captured_by, consent_flag, raw_ocr_text, company)?

4) Failure handling: If OCR confidence < 0.7, we want a fallback to manual entry queue with an image link for ops to correct.

If that all sounds feasible, let's schedule a 30-min pairing on Tuesday and a short pilot at the concierge desk Wed morning.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Field Marketing Ops | Redwood Inference

From: ScanFast Integration <integrations@scanfast.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@scanfast.io>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Business-card OCR fallback option for Summit A booths

On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 8:45 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Laura — this looks promising. A few quick notes from our side:
>
> 1) Privacy / consent: We need explicit opt-in language before capturing images. Can you support a short consent banner that stores a consent flag with each record (timestamp + captured_by)? We can expose that flag in HubSpot and add it to the event record.

Yes — we support a consent modal in the mobile UI. We can record: consent_given (boolean), consent_ts (ISO), captured_by (internal user id), and capture_device_id. Those fields will be included in the webhook payload. We will drop images from our servers after a configurable TTL (we can do 14 days).

> 2) Data retention: For compliance we want images deleted after 14 days by default. OCR text can be kept longer if consented. Is that configurable?

Yes — configurable per account. Default 14 days for images, 365 days for text unless you request otherwise.

> 3) HubSpot mapping: Ben, can you confirm the target properties we should map to (source, captured_by, consent_flag, raw_ocr_text, company)?

We can map to any HubSpot contact/company custom fields via the integration. We also support a preflight sync to a staging list.

> 4) Failure handling: If OCR confidence < 0.7, we want a fallback to manual entry queue with an image link for ops to correct.

We will include confidence score and an image_url in the webhook. Low confidence records can be routed to your manual queue via a HubSpot workflow that adds a task to the event-team owner queue.

Attached: scanfast_businesscard-ocr-spec_v1.2.pdf

Next steps
- Provide HubSpot property names (Ben)
- Confirm retention windows (Mateo)
- Book a 30-min pilot slot with your kiosk (Vanessa)

Thanks,
ScanFast Integrations Team

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Business-card OCR fallback option for Summit A booths

Mateo — mapping below (HubSpot contact properties we control):
- properties.source (string) => event_capture
- properties.captured_by (string) => rep_email
- properties.consent_flag (boolean) => consent_given
- properties.ocr_raw_text (multi-line text) => raw_ocr_text
- properties.company_name => company
- properties.scan_confidence (number) => ocr_confidence

I recommend we first route everything to a staging list called "SummitA_manual_capture" and have CSQA approve records with confidence < 0.75. If ops are comfortable after pilot, we can switch to direct ingestion.

Also note: HubSpot rate limits mean we should batch webhooks (ScanFast supports 5/s) — we'll add a Redis-backed buffer in our small ingestion lambda.

—Ben
Sr. Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@scanfast.io>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Business-card OCR fallback option for Summit A booths

Thanks everyone — approved to pilot at Summit A concierge for Wed morning slot (8:30–10:30). Mateo, please coordinate with onsite ops to bring two phones and one tablet. Laura — please send the APK and a quick install note by EOD today. Ben — please stand by to monitor staging list and help tune the threshold.

One ask for legal: Please include the consent text exactly as: "By capturing this card/image I consent to Redwood Inference storing contact information for follow-up regarding Summit A. Images will be deleted after 14 days unless I opt in to longer retention." We'll surface that verbatim on the modal.

See floor map attached (summitA-floorplan-v3.png).

Thanks,
